description.value: Happy Valley Food City is a large multi-concept Chinese dining venue on Lougheed Highway in Burnaby, housing both 'Wonder House' (dim sum lunches and Cantonese seafood dinners) and 'HV Cafe' (Hong Kong-style cafe serving breakfast and cafe fare all day). The restaurant also offers frozen prepared foods for sale and online ordering with pickup or delivery. Wheelchair access is confirmed via OSM.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Happy Valley Food City is an active multi-concept Chinese restaurant in Burnaby featuring 'Wonder House' (dim sum and Cantonese seafood dinner) and 'HV Cafe' (HK-style cafe), with a 2026 copyright date on the order subpage indicating current operation. Pickup and delivery ordering are confirmed via the website's Square-powered ordering system. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tags this as amenity=restaurant, but the venue functions more as a multi-concept food hall with at least two distinct sub-brands (Wonder House and HV Cafe); the tag is not wrong but is an understatement.
Phone number in OSM (+1-604-990-7077) could not be cross-verified from the fetched website content — no phone number was visible in the page text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and current promotions. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or takeout on Lougheed Highway in Burnaby.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website also advertises frozen prepared foods for sale, which may be of interest to touring cyclists looking to stock up.
